---
name: Bug report
about: Something in EarTrainer/LearnerEQ/LearnerComp/LearnerVerb doesn't work as expected
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Which plugin?**
EarTrainer / LearnerEQ / LearnerComp / LearnerVerb

**Format and host**
VST3 / AU / Standalone — DAW/host name and version (or "Standalone" if not in a host).

**OS and version**
e.g. macOS 14.5 (Apple Silicon), Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04.

**Build**
Version string shown in the plugin (or `git describe` output if you built it
yourself) — see [decisions/012](../../docs/decisions/012-versioning.md) for
what that string means.

**What happened**
A clear description of the bug.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen instead.

**Screenshots/logs**
If applicable — a screenshot, a DAW crash log, or console output helps a lot.

**Anything else?**
Any other context (project sample rate, buffer size, whether it happens with
every project or just one, etc.).
